summary.zh: 日本关东军炸毁南满铁路柳条湖段并进攻沈阳北大营，中国抗日战争由此开始。
summary.en: The Japanese Kwantung Army blew up the South Manchuria Railway near Liutiaohu and attacked Beidaying in Shenyang, beginning China’s war of resistance.

description.zh:
1931 年 9 月 18 日夜，日本关东军自行炸毁沈阳北郊柳条湖附近的南满铁路路轨，反诬中国军队所为，随即进攻东北军北大营和沈阳城。此后数月，日军侵占东北大部。

本事件日期与地点为通行说法，具体战斗经过待史料校订。
description.en:
On the night of 18 September 1931, the Japanese Kwantung Army destroyed a section of the South Manchuria Railway near Liutiaohu, blamed Chinese troops, and attacked Beidaying and Shenyang. Within months Japanese forces occupied most of the Northeast.

Dates and locations follow conventional accounts; details await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

summary.zh: 日军进攻上海闸北，第十九路军等部奋起抵抗，淞沪地区爆发激烈战斗。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Zhabei in Shanghai; the 19th Route Army and other Chinese units resisted in fierce fighting.

description.zh:
1932 年 1 月 28 日，日军以保护侨民为借口进攻上海闸北。第十九路军在蒋光鼐、蔡廷锴指挥下抵抗，双方在淞沪地区激战至 3 月。5 月，中日签订《淞沪停战协定》。

本事件日期与地点为通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 28 January 1932, Japanese forces attacked Zhabei in Shanghai under the pretext of protecting residents. The 19th Route Army, commanded by Jiang Guangnai and Cai Tingkai, resisted until March. In May, China and Japan signed the Shanghai Ceasefire Agreement.

Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

summary.zh: 日军占领哈尔滨，东北主要城市至此基本沦陷。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Harbin, completing the occupation of the Northeast’s major cities.

description.zh:
1932 年 2 月 5 日，日军进入哈尔滨。此前齐齐哈尔、锦州等地已相继失守，东北三省主要城市至此基本被日军控制。

本事件为路线分段端点，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
Japanese troops entered Harbin on 5 February 1932. Qiqihar, Jinzhou, and other cities had already fallen, leaving the major cities of the three northeastern provinces largely under Japanese control.

This event marks a route segment endpoint; the date follows conventional accounts and awaits historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

place.en: Changchun, Jilin (called “Xinjing” by the puppet state)

summary.zh: 日本扶植溥仪在长春成立伪满洲国，东北被纳入日本殖民统治体系。
summary.en: Japan installed Puyi as head of the puppet state of Manchukuo in Changchun, placing the Northeast under colonial rule.

description.zh:
1932 年 3 月 1 日，日本扶植清朝末代皇帝溥仪在长春成立伪满洲国，随后以“日满议定书”等形式加以控制。中国政府与国际联盟均未承认该政权。

本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。
description.en:
On 1 March 1932, Japan installed Puyi, the last Qing emperor, as head of the puppet state of Manchukuo in Changchun, later controlling it through agreements such as the Japan-Manchukuo Protocol. Neither the Chinese government nor the League of Nations recognized the regime.

This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

sources.title: 《剑桥中华民国史》
sources.author: 费正清、费维恺编
sources.note: 伪满政权建立背景参考

summary.zh: 北平学生举行抗日救亡请愿游行，推动全国抗日救亡运动高涨。
summary.en: Students in Beiping marched to demand resistance and national salvation, helping to galvanize anti-Japanese sentiment nationwide.

description.zh:
1935 年 12 月 9 日，北平学生数千人举行抗日救亡请愿游行，反对华北自治，要求停止内战、一致对外。运动迅速扩展到全国，成为抗日民族统一战线形成的重要背景。

本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。
description.en:
On 9 December 1935, thousands of students in Beiping demonstrated against the autonomy movement in North China and called for an end to civil war and united resistance. The movement spread nationwide and became an important backdrop to the formation of the anti-Japanese united front.

This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

summary.zh: 张学良、杨虎城在西安扣留蒋介石，促成停止内战、联共抗日的转折。
summary.en: Zhang Xueliang and Yang Hucheng detained Chiang Kai-shek in Xi’an, leading to a turn toward ending the civil war and resisting Japan.

description.zh:
1936 年 12 月 12 日，东北军将领张学良与第十七路军将领杨虎城在西安扣留蒋介石，要求停止内战、一致抗日。经多方斡旋，事变和平解决，为抗日民族统一战线的形成创造了条件。

本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。
description.en:
On 12 December 1936, Zhang Xueliang of the Northeast Army and Yang Hucheng of the 17th Route Army detained Chiang Kai-shek in Xi’an, demanding an end to the civil war and united resistance against Japan. The incident was resolved peacefully, helping pave the way for the anti-Japanese united front.

This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

sources.title: 《中华民国史》
sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所

summary.zh: 日军在卢沟桥附近挑起冲突并进攻宛平城，中国全面抗战由此爆发。
summary.en: Japanese forces provoked a clash near the Marco Polo Bridge and attacked Wanping, marking the start of full-scale Chinese resistance.

description.zh:
1937 年 7 月 7 日夜，日军在北平西南卢沟桥附近演习，借口士兵失踪要求进入宛平城搜查，遭拒后发动进攻。中国守军第二十九军奋起抵抗，战事迅速扩大。

本事件为路线分段端点，日期与地点为通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On the night of 7 July 1937, Japanese troops on exercise near the Marco Polo Bridge demanded entry into Wanping to search for a missing soldier. After being refused, they attacked. The Chinese 29th Army resisted, and the fighting quickly escalated.

This event marks a route segment endpoint; date and location follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

summary.zh: 中日双方在上海投入重兵鏖战三个月，中国军队粉碎了日军速战速决的企图。
summary.en: China and Japan poured troops into three months of fighting in Shanghai, thwarting Japan’s hope for a quick victory.

description.zh:
1937 年 8 月 13 日，淞沪会战爆发。中国军队先后投入数十万兵力，与日军在上海市区及周边反复争夺。11 月，中国军队西撤，上海沦陷，但会战打破了日军“三个月灭亡中国”的计划。

本事件为路线分段端点，日期与战果表述待史料校订。
description.en:
The Battle of Shanghai began on 13 August 1937. Hundreds of thousands of Chinese troops fought Japanese forces in and around the city. In November the Chinese army withdrew west and Shanghai fell, but the battle shattered Japan’s plan to conquer China in three months.

This event marks a route segment endpoint; dates and assessments await historical review.

sources.title: 《中国人民解放军战史》
sources.author: 军事科学院军事历史研究部

summary.zh: 八路军第一一五师在平型关伏击日军，取得全面抗战初期的重要胜利。
summary.en: The 115th Division of the Eighth Route Army ambushed Japanese troops at Pingxingguan, winning an important early victory.

description.zh:
1937 年 9 月 25 日，八路军第一一五师在山西灵丘平型关东北的乔沟一带伏击日军第五师团第二十一旅团一部及辎重部队，歼敌数百人，击毁汽车、马车多辆。

本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 25 September 1937, the 115th Division of the Eighth Route Army ambushed part of the Japanese 5th Division’s 21st Brigade and its supply column near Qiaogou, northeast of Pingxingguan in Lingqiu, Shanxi, killing several hundred Japanese troops and destroying vehicles and wagons.

Date, location, and casualties follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《中国人民解放军战史》
sources.author: 军事科学院军事历史研究部

name.zh: 南京沦陷与南京大屠杀
name.en: Fall of Nanjing and the Nanjing Massacre

summary.zh: 日军攻占南京后对平民和战俘实施大规模屠杀、强奸与劫掠，造成惨重伤亡。
summary.en: After capturing Nanjing, Japanese forces carried out mass killings, rape, and looting against civilians and prisoners of war.

description.zh:
1937 年 12 月 13 日，日军攻占南京。随后数周内，日军在南京及周边地区对放下武器的中国军人和无辜平民实施大规模屠杀、强奸、纵火与抢劫。远东国际军事法庭认定伤亡规模巨大。

本事件为路线分段端点，具体伤亡数字存在不同统计口径，待史料校订。
description.en:
Japanese forces captured Nanjing on 13 December 1937. In the following weeks they carried out mass killings, rape, arson, and looting against disarmed Chinese soldiers and civilians in and around the city. The International Military Tribunal for the Far East found the scale of the atrocities to be enormous.

This event marks a route segment endpoint; casualty figures vary among accounts and await historical review.

place.zh: 山东峄县台儿庄（今枣庄）

summary.zh: 中国军队在台儿庄地区重创日军，取得正面战场的一次重大胜利。
summary.en: Chinese forces inflicted a major defeat on Japanese troops at Taierzhuang, a significant victory on the frontal battlefield.

description.zh:
1938 年 3 月至 4 月，中国军队在第五战区司令长官李宗仁指挥下，于山东台儿庄地区与日军第十师团等部激战，最终取得台儿庄大捷。此役是徐州会战的重要组成部分。

本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
From March to April 1938, Chinese forces under Li Zongren, commander of the Fifth War Zone, fought Japanese units including the 10th Division at Taierzhuang in Shandong, winning a major victory. The battle was an important part of the Xuzhou campaign.

Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《中国人民解放军战史》
sources.author: 军事科学院军事历史研究部

summary.zh: 日军在广东大亚湾登陆后迅速推进，占领广州，华南门户失守。
summary.en: Japanese forces landed at Daya Bay in Guangdong and quickly captured Guangzhou, opening the gateway to South China.

description.zh:
1938 年 10 月，日军在广东大亚湾登陆，沿公路向广州推进。10 月 21 日广州失守，中国南方重要港口与对外通道被日军控制。

本事件日期与地点为通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In October 1938, Japanese forces landed at Daya Bay in Guangdong and advanced along roads toward Guangzhou. The city fell on 21 October, placing an important southern port and external supply route under Japanese control.

Date and location follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

summary.zh: 武汉会战后日军占领武汉，抗日战争进入战略相持阶段。
summary.en: After the Battle of Wuhan, Japanese forces captured the city, and the war entered a phase of strategic stalemate.

description.zh:
1938 年 6 月起，日军沿长江南北进攻武汉。中国军队组织武汉会战，激战数月后于 10 月撤出。10 月 25 日武汉失守，国民政府机关此前已迁往重庆，抗日战争逐步进入战略相持阶段。

本事件为路线相关节点，日期与表述待史料校订。
description.en:
From June 1938, Japanese forces advanced on Wuhan from both sides of the Yangtze. Chinese troops fought the Battle of Wuhan for months before withdrawing in October. Wuhan fell on 25 October; government organs had already moved to Chongqing, and the war gradually entered a phase of strategic stalemate.

This event is linked to route segments; dates and wording await historical review.

sources.title: 《中国人民解放军战史》
sources.author: 军事科学院军事历史研究部

summary.zh: 日军进攻长沙，中国军队在新墙河、汨罗江一线阻击并反击，恢复原阵地。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Changsha; Chinese troops blocked and counterattacked along the Xinqiang and Miluo rivers, restoring their original positions.

description.zh:
1939 年 9 月 14 日，日军集中兵力向湖南新墙河一线发起进攻，企图攻取长沙。中国军队第九战区部队逐次阻击，诱敌深入后侧击、反击，迫使日军于 10 月上旬退回原阵地。此役是抗战进入相持阶段后中国正面战场的一次重要防御作战。

本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 14 September 1939, Japanese forces launched an offensive across the Xinqiang River in Hunan in an attempt to take Changsha. Chinese troops of the Ninth War Zone resisted in stages, drew the Japanese forward, then struck their flanks and counterattacked, forcing a withdrawal to the original line in early October. It was an important defensive battle on China’s frontal battlefield during the stalemate phase.

Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

summary.zh: 日军进攻枣阳、宜昌地区，中国军队顽强抵抗，张自忠殉国，宜昌最终失守。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked the Zaoyang and Yichang areas; Chinese troops resisted stubbornly, Zhang Zizhong was killed, and Yichang eventually fell.

description.zh:
1940 年 5 月，日军第十一军向枣阳、襄阳、宜昌地区发动进攻，企图歼灭中国第五战区主力并控制长江上游门户。中国军队在枣阳、襄阳一线抵抗，第 33 集团军总司令张自忠在宜城南瓜店战斗中殉国。6 月，宜昌失守。此役中国军队伤亡重大，但保持了战区主力。

本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。
description.en:
In May 1940, the Japanese 11th Army attacked the Zaoyang, Xiangyang, and Yichang areas, seeking to destroy the main forces of China’s Fifth War Zone and control the upper Yangtze gateway. Chinese troops resisted along the Zaoyang–Xiangyang line, and Zhang Zizhong, commander of the 33rd Army Group, was killed in action near Nanguadian in Yicheng. Yichang fell in June. Chinese forces suffered heavy casualties but preserved the bulk of the war zone’s strength.

Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

sources.title: 《中国事变陆军作战史》
sources.author: 日本防卫厅防卫研修所战史室

sources.title: 《中华民国史》
sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所

summary.zh: 日军再次进攻长沙，中国军队逐次抵抗并反击，日军于 10 月上旬退回原阵地。
summary.en: Japanese forces again attacked Changsha; Chinese troops resisted in stages and counterattacked, forcing a Japanese withdrawal to the original line in early October.

description.zh:
1941 年 9 月，日军第十一军向新墙河、汨罗江一线发起进攻，企图击破中国第九战区主力并攻取长沙。中国军队逐次抵抗，双方在长沙外围激战；日军因补给困难和中国军队侧击，于 10 月上旬退回原阵地。此役双方均有较大伤亡。

本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。
description.en:
In September 1941, the Japanese 11th Army attacked across the Xinqiang and Miluo rivers, aiming to destroy the main forces of China’s Ninth War Zone and take Changsha. Chinese troops resisted in stages and fought fierce actions on the city’s outskirts. Hampered by supply difficulties and Chinese flank attacks, the Japanese withdrew to their original line in early October. Both sides suffered considerable casualties.

Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

sources.title: 《中国事变陆军作战史》
sources.author: 日本防卫厅防卫研修所战史室

summary.zh: 日军第三次进攻长沙，中国军队以“天炉战法”诱敌深入并反击，取得长沙大捷。
summary.en: Japan attacked Changsha for the third time; Chinese forces drew the Japanese in and counterattacked, winning a major victory.

description.zh:
1941 年 12 月 24 日，日军第十一军再次向长沙进攻。中国第九战区司令长官薛岳采取“天炉战法”，以一部兵力逐次抵抗、诱敌深入，主力从外围侧击、合围。日军攻入长沙外围后补给困难，被迫撤退；中国军队追击，至 1942 年 1 月中旬恢复原阵地。此役是太平洋战争爆发后中国正面战场的一次重要胜利。

本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 24 December 1941, the Japanese 11th Army attacked Changsha again. Xue Yue, commander of China’s Ninth War Zone, employed the “heavenly furnace” tactic: a covering force resisted in stages and drew the Japanese inward while the main force struck the flanks and closed the ring. After reaching the outskirts of Changsha, the Japanese faced supply difficulties and were forced to retreat. Chinese forces pursued and restored the original line by mid-January 1942. It was an important victory on China’s frontal battlefield after the outbreak of the Pacific War.

Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

sources.title: 《中国事变陆军作战史》
sources.author: 日本防卫厅防卫研修所战史室

place.zh: 华北正太铁路沿线（阳泉一带）
place.en: Along the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway in North China (Yangquan area)

summary.zh: 八路军在华北发动大规模破袭战，打击日军交通线与据点。
summary.en: The Eighth Route Army launched a large-scale sabotage campaign against Japanese transport lines and strongpoints in North China.

description.zh:
1940 年 8 月 20 日起，八路军在华北发动以破袭正太铁路为重点的大规模进攻，先后参战部队达一百余个团。战役持续至 1941 年初，对日军交通线和据点造成较大打击，也引起日军对华北敌后根据地的更残酷“扫荡”。

本事件日期、地点与规模表述待史料校订。
description.en:
Beginning on 20 August 1940, the Eighth Route Army launched a large offensive in North China centered on sabotaging the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway, with more than a hundred regiments eventually taking part. The campaign lasted into early 1941, damaging Japanese transport lines and strongpoints and prompting harsher Japanese “mopping-up” operations against base areas.

Dates, location, and scale await historical review.

sources.title: 《中国人民解放军战史》
sources.author: 军事科学院军事历史研究部

summary.zh: 日军围攻中条山中国守军，中国军队遭受重大损失，被迫南渡黄河突围。
summary.en: Japanese forces besieged Chinese troops in the Zhongtiao Mountains; the Chinese army suffered heavy losses and was forced to break out south across the Yellow River.

description.zh:
1941 年 5 月，日军集中兵力围攻山西南部中条山地区的中国军队。中国守军补给困难、指挥协同不足，在日军多路进攻下遭受重大损失，部分部队南渡黄河突围。此役是抗战中期中国正面战场的一次严重失利。

本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。
description.en:
In May 1941, Japanese forces concentrated their strength to besiege Chinese troops in the Zhongtiao Mountains of southern Shanxi. Hampered by supply difficulties and poor coordination, the Chinese defenders suffered heavy losses under multiple Japanese attacks, and part of the force broke out south across the Yellow River. It was a serious setback for China’s frontal battlefield in the middle years of the war.

Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

sources.title: 《中国事变陆军作战史》
sources.author: 日本防卫厅防卫研修所战史室

sources.title: 《中华民国史》
sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所

summary.zh: 日本海军偷袭珍珠港，太平洋战争爆发，中国抗战与世界大战连为一体。
summary.en: The Japanese navy attacked Pearl Harbor, starting the Pacific War and linking China’s resistance to the global conflict.

description.zh:
1941 年 12 月 7 日（夏威夷时间），日本海军袭击美国太平洋舰队基地珍珠港。美国随即对日宣战，太平洋战争爆发。中国战场成为世界反法西斯战争的重要组成部分。

本事件为国际事件，不绘制路线；日期按夏威夷时间标注，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 7 December 1941 (Hawaii time), the Japanese navy attacked the US Pacific Fleet base at Pearl Harbor. The United States declared war on Japan, and the Pacific War began. The China theater became an important part of the global anti-fascist war.

This is an international event with no route drawn; the date follows Hawaii time and awaits historical review.

sources.title: 《第二次世界大战史》
sources.author: 军事科学院军事历史研究部

sources.title: 《中国抗日战争史》
sources.author: 张宪文等
sources.note: 太平洋战争与中国战场关系参考

summary.zh: 太平洋战争爆发后，中国政府正式对日本、德国、意大利宣战。
summary.en: After the Pacific War began, the Chinese government formally declared war on Japan, Germany, and Italy.

description.zh:
1941 年 12 月 9 日，中国国民政府对日本、德国、意大利正式宣战，并宣布与三国所订一切条约、协定、合同一律废止。中国抗战由此更紧密地融入世界反法西斯同盟。

本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。
description.en:
On 9 December 1941, the Chinese National Government formally declared war on Japan, Germany, and Italy and annulled all treaties, agreements, and contracts with them. China’s resistance became more closely integrated into the global anti-fascist alliance.

This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

sources.title: 《中华民国史》
sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所

summary.zh: 中国远征军自云南入缅，与盟军协同保卫滇缅公路。
summary.en: The Chinese Expeditionary Force entered Burma from Yunnan to help defend the Burma Road alongside Allied forces.

description.zh:
1942 年初，为保卫滇缅公路和支援盟军，中国远征军陆续自云南入缅，与英军协同作战。远征军在缅北、缅中地区与日军激战，后因战局不利而撤退。

本事件日期取 1942 年 2 月的示意时间点，具体入缅日期待史料校订。
description.en:
In early 1942, to defend the Burma Road and support the Allies, the Chinese Expeditionary Force entered Burma from Yunnan and fought alongside British troops. It engaged Japanese forces in northern and central Burma before withdrawing under unfavorable conditions.

The date is an illustrative point in February 1942; the exact entry dates await historical review.

sources.title: 《第二次世界大战史》
sources.author: 军事科学院军事历史研究部

summary.zh: 缅甸战局失利后，中国远征军部分部队撤往印度，后整编为中国驻印军。
summary.en: After setbacks in Burma, part of the Chinese Expeditionary Force withdrew to India and was later reorganized as the Chinese Army in India.

description.zh:
1942 年 5 月前后，缅甸战局恶化，中国远征军部分部队经野人山等路线撤往印度，损失惨重；另一部分退回云南。撤至印度的部队后来在兰姆伽整训，整编为中国驻印军。

本事件日期为示意时间点，撤退路线与时间待史料校订。
description.en:
Around May 1942, as the situation in Burma deteriorated, part of the Chinese Expeditionary Force withdrew to India through difficult routes including the Naga Hills, suffering heavy losses; another part returned to Yunnan. The troops in India were later reorganized and trained at Ramgarh as the Chinese Army in India.

The date is an illustrative point; retreat routes and timing await historical review.

sources.title: 《中国抗日战争史》
sources.author: 张宪文等
sources.note: 远征军撤退与整训参考

summary.zh: 日军进攻鄂西，中国军队在石牌要塞一带顽强阻击，挫败日军攻势。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked western Hubei; Chinese troops stubbornly defended the Shipai fortress area and thwarted the offensive.

description.zh:
1943 年 5 月，日军第十一军向鄂西地区进攻，企图夺取石牌要塞、威胁重庆。中国第六战区部队依托长江三峡地形顽强抵抗，在石牌一带与日军激战，最终迫使日军撤退。此役是抗战后期正面战场的一次重要防御胜利。

本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。
description.en:
In May 1943, the Japanese 11th Army attacked western Hubei, seeking to seize the Shipai fortress and threaten Chongqing. Chinese troops of the Sixth War Zone used the terrain of the Three Gorges to resist stubbornly, fighting fierce actions around Shipai and eventually forcing the Japanese to withdraw. It was an important defensive victory on China’s frontal battlefield in the later war years.

Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

sources.title: 《中国事变陆军作战史》
sources.author: 日本防卫厅防卫研修所战史室

sources.title: 《中华民国史》
sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所

name.en: Start of the Northern Burma Counteroffensive

summary.zh: 中国驻印军与盟军自印度利多出发，向缅北日军发起反攻。
summary.en: Chinese forces in India and Allied troops advanced from Ledo to counterattack Japanese forces in northern Burma.

description.zh:
1943 年 10 月起，中国驻印军新一军等部与美军部队自印度利多出发，向缅北推进，先后进行胡康河谷、孟拱河谷等战役，为打通中印公路创造条件。

本事件日期为示意时间点，作战经过待史料校订。
description.en:
Beginning in October 1943, the Chinese Army in India, including the New 1st Army, and US units advanced from Ledo into northern Burma, fighting in the Hukawng and Mogaung valleys and helping to open the Ledo Road.

The date is an illustrative point; operational details await historical review.

sources.title: 《第二次世界大战史》
sources.author: 军事科学院军事历史研究部

summary.zh: 日军进攻常德，中国守军坚守多日后突围，中国军队随后反攻收复常德。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Changde; the Chinese garrison held out for days before breaking out, and Chinese troops counterattacked to recover the city.

description.zh:
1943 年 11 月，日军第十一军向常德地区发起进攻，企图牵制中国军队并夺取洞庭湖周边粮区。中国第 74 军第 57 师坚守常德城，与日军激战多日，伤亡惨重后突围。中国军队外围部队随即反攻，12 月收复常德。此役战斗激烈，双方均有重大伤亡。

本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。
description.en:
In November 1943, the Japanese 11th Army attacked the Changde area, seeking to pin down Chinese forces and seize the rice-producing region around Dongting Lake. The 57th Division of the Chinese 74th Army defended Changde in bitter fighting for many days before breaking out with heavy losses. Chinese forces on the periphery counterattacked and recovered the city in December. Both sides suffered major casualties.

Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

sources.title: 《中国事变陆军作战史》
sources.author: 日本防卫厅防卫研修所战史室

sources.title: 《中华民国史》
sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所

summary.zh: 中美英三国领导人举行开罗会议，发表《开罗宣言》，明确战后归还中国领土。
summary.en: Leaders of China, the United States, and Britain met in Cairo and issued the Cairo Declaration, affirming the return of Chinese territories after the war.

description.zh:
1943 年 11 月 22 日至 26 日，蒋介石、罗斯福、丘吉尔在开罗举行会议，讨论对日作战与战后安排。会议发表的《开罗宣言》明确表示，日本所窃取于中国的领土，如东北、台湾、澎湖列岛等，应归还中国。

本事件为外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。
description.en:
From 22 to 26 November 1943, Chiang Kai-shek, Franklin D. Roosevelt, and Winston Churchill met in Cairo to discuss the war against Japan and postwar arrangements. The Cairo Declaration stated that territories Japan had seized from China, including the Northeast, Taiwan, and the Penghu Islands, should be returned to China.

This is a diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

sources.title: 《开罗宣言》

sources.title: 《第二次世界大战史》
sources.author: 军事科学院军事历史研究部

summary.zh: 日军发动豫湘桂战役，沿平汉、湘桂铁路南犯，中国正面战场遭受重大损失。
summary.en: Japan launched Operation Ichi-Go south along the Beijing–Hankou and Hunan–Guangxi railways, inflicting heavy losses on China’s frontal battlefield.

description.zh:
1944 年 4 月 17 日，日军发动豫湘桂战役，先后在河南、湖南、广西等地进攻。中国军队虽顽强抵抗，但郑州、长沙、衡阳、桂林、柳州、南宁等地相继失守，正面战场遭受抗战后期最严重的挫折之一。

本事件日期与范围取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 17 April 1944, Japan launched Operation Ichi-Go, attacking across Henan, Hunan, and Guangxi. Despite stubborn Chinese resistance, Zhengzhou, Changsha, Hengyang, Guilin, Liuzhou, and Nanning fell in succession, one of the most serious setbacks for China’s frontal battlefield in the later war years.

Dates and extent follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《中国事变陆军作战史》
sources.author: 日本防卫厅防卫研修所战史室

summary.zh: 中国远征军围攻松山日军据点，经苦战收复松山，打通滇缅公路关键节点。
summary.en: The Chinese Expeditionary Force captured the Japanese stronghold at Songshan after bitter fighting, opening a key point on the Burma Road.

description.zh:
1944 年 6 月至 9 月，中国远征军对云南龙陵松山日军据点发起进攻。日军依托坚固工事顽抗，中国军队付出重大伤亡，最终于 9 月 7 日收复松山，为滇西反攻和滇缅公路恢复通车创造条件。

本事件日期、地点与战果待史料校订。
description.en:
From June to September 1944, the Chinese Expeditionary Force attacked the Japanese stronghold at Songshan in Longling, Yunnan. Japanese troops resisted from fortified positions, and Chinese forces suffered heavy casualties before recapturing Songshan on 7 September, facilitating the western Yunnan counteroffensive and the reopening of the Burma Road.

Dates, location, and assessments await historical review.

summary.zh: 中国第 10 军坚守衡阳 47 天，重创日军，最终衡阳失守。
summary.en: The Chinese 10th Army held Hengyang for 47 days, inflicting heavy losses on Japanese forces before the city fell.

description.zh:
1944 年 6 月，日军在豫湘桂战役中进攻衡阳。中国第 10 军约一万七千人坚守衡阳，面对优势日军的围攻，苦战 47 天，伤亡惨重，弹尽援绝，衡阳于 8 月 8 日失守。此役迟滞了日军南进，是抗战后期著名的城市防御战。

本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为城防示意，待史料校订。
description.en:
In June 1944, Japanese forces attacked Hengyang during Operation Ichi-Go. The Chinese 10th Army, about 17,000 strong, defended the city against a numerically superior Japanese siege for 47 days. With heavy casualties, ammunition exhausted, and no relief in sight, Hengyang fell on 8 August. The defense delayed the Japanese advance south and became one of the best-known urban defense battles of the later war years.

Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a sketch of the city defense and awaits historical review.

sources.title: 《中国事变陆军作战史》
sources.author: 日本防卫厅防卫研修所战史室

sources.title: 《中华民国史》
sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所

summary.zh: 日军在豫湘桂战役中占领南宁，打通大陆交通线的企图一度得逞。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Nanning during Operation Ichi-Go, temporarily achieving their aim of opening a continental transport route.

description.zh:
1944 年 11 月，日军在豫湘桂战役中继续南犯，11 月 24 日占领南宁。日军企图打通从华北到印度支那的大陆交通线，但战线过长、兵力分散，难以长期巩固。

本事件为路线分段端点，日期与地点为通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In November 1944, Japanese forces continued south during Operation Ichi-Go and captured Nanning on 24 November. Japan sought to open a continental transport route from North China to Indochina, but overextended lines and dispersed forces made it difficult to hold.

This event marks a route segment endpoint; date and location follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《中国事变陆军作战史》
sources.author: 日本防卫厅防卫研修所战史室

summary.zh: 盟军与中国驻印军收复曼德勒，缅北反攻取得重要进展。
summary.en: Allied and Chinese forces recaptured Mandalay, a major advance in the northern Burma counteroffensive.

description.zh:
1945 年 3 月，盟军与中国驻印军在缅北反攻中推进至曼德勒地区，并于 3 月 20 日收复曼德勒。此后盟军继续南下，缅甸战局趋于明朗。

本事件为路线分段端点，日期与作战归属表述待史料校订。
description.en:
In March 1945, Allied and Chinese forces in the northern Burma counteroffensive reached the Mandalay area and recaptured the city on 20 March. Allied forces continued southward, and the situation in Burma became increasingly clear.

This event marks a route segment endpoint; dates and unit attributions await historical review.

sources.title: 《第二次世界大战史》
sources.author: 军事科学院军事历史研究部

summary.zh: 中国军队在广西发起反攻，先后收复桂林、柳州、南宁等地。
summary.en: Chinese forces counterattacked in Guangxi, recovering Guilin, Liuzhou, and Nanning.

description.zh:
1945 年 5 月起，中国军队在广西发起局部反攻，逐步收复豫湘桂战役中失守的城镇。随着日本宣布投降，桂柳、南宁等地相继光复。

本事件日期为示意时间点，具体作战进程待史料校订。
description.en:
From May 1945, Chinese forces launched a limited counteroffensive in Guangxi, gradually recovering towns lost during Operation Ichi-Go. With Japan’s announcement of surrender, Guilin, Liuzhou, Nanning, and other places were recovered.

The date is an illustrative point; operational details await historical review.

sources.title: 《中国人民解放军战史》
sources.author: 军事科学院军事历史研究部

summary.zh: 美国在广岛投下原子弹，加速了日本投降的进程。
summary.en: The United States dropped an atomic bomb on Hiroshima, accelerating Japan’s surrender.

description.zh:
1945 年 8 月 6 日，美国在日本广岛投下原子弹，造成大量人员伤亡。8 月 9 日，美国又在长崎投下原子弹。核打击与苏联出兵东北共同加速了日本投降。

本事件为国际事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。
description.en:
On 6 August 1945, the United States dropped an atomic bomb on Hiroshima, causing massive casualties. On 9 August, another bomb was dropped on Nagasaki. The nuclear strikes, together with the Soviet entry into the war in the Northeast, accelerated Japan’s surrender.

This is an international event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

sources.author: 张宪文等

name.zh: 苏联对日宣战与出兵东北
name.en: Soviet Declaration of War on Japan and Invasion of the Northeast

summary.zh: 苏联对日宣战并出兵中国东北，关东军迅速崩溃。
summary.en: The Soviet Union declared war on Japan and invaded Northeast China, rapidly collapsing the Kwantung Army.

description.zh:
1945 年 8 月 8 日（莫斯科时间），苏联对日宣战；8 月 9 日，苏军从东、北、西三个方向进入中国东北和朝鲜北部，进攻日本关东军。关东军在短时间内瓦解，日本投降进程明显加快。

本事件为国际事件，不绘制路线；日期按中国通行的 8 月 9 日标注，地点取东北方向示意点，待史料校订。
description.en:
The Soviet Union declared war on Japan on 8 August 1945 (Moscow time); on 9 August, Soviet forces entered Northeast China and northern Korea from the east, north, and west, attacking the Japanese Kwantung Army. The Kwantung Army collapsed quickly, significantly accelerating Japan’s surrender.

This is an international event with no route drawn; the date follows the conventional Chinese usage of 9 August, and the location is an illustrative point in the Northeast pending historical review.

sources.title: 《第二次世界大战史》
sources.author: 军事科学院军事历史研究部

sources.title: 《中国抗日战争史》
sources.author: 张宪文等
sources.note: 苏联出兵东北背景参考

summary.zh: 日本天皇广播《终战诏书》，宣布接受《波茨坦公告》，中国抗日战争取得胜利。
summary.en: The Japanese emperor broadcast the rescript accepting the Potsdam Declaration, bringing victory in China’s war of resistance.

description.zh:
1945 年 8 月 15 日，日本天皇裕仁通过广播发布《终战诏书》，宣布接受中美英苏四国发表的《波茨坦公告》，实际上宣布无条件投降。中国各地举行庆祝活动，抗日战争取得胜利。

本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。
description.en:
On 15 August 1945, Emperor Hirohito broadcast the Imperial Rescript on the Termination of the War, accepting the Potsdam Declaration issued by China, the United States, Britain, and the Soviet Union—in effect announcing unconditional surrender. Celebrations took place across China, marking victory in the war of resistance.

This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

name.en: Signing of the Japanese Instrument of Surrender

place.zh: 日本东京湾美国“密苏里”号战列舰

summary.zh: 日本代表在东京湾签署投降书，第二次世界大战正式结束。
summary.en: Japanese representatives signed the instrument of surrender in Tokyo Bay, formally ending the Second World War.

description.zh:
1945 年 9 月 2 日，日本政府代表在东京湾美国“密苏里”号战列舰上签署投降书，中、美、英、苏等同盟国代表签字接受。至此，中国抗日战争与第二次世界大战正式结束。

本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点为通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 2 September 1945, Japanese government representatives signed the instrument of surrender aboard the USS Missouri in Tokyo Bay, and representatives of the Allied powers, including China, the United States, Britain, and the Soviet Union, accepted it. China’s war of resistance and the Second World War formally ended.

This is a political event with no route drawn; date and location follow conventional accounts and await historical review.
